explanation.question_quote: The chest pain occurs after climbing more than 2 flight of stairs or walking for more than 10 minutes and resolves with rest.
explanation.sentence: His chest pain comes on predictably with stair climbing or prolonged walking and resolves with rest.
This pattern is characteristic of stable angina, in which a fixed atherosclerotic stenosis greater than 70% limits coronary blood flow when myocardial oxygen demand increases during exertion.
In contrast, vasospastic angina is usually unrelated to exertion, a nonocclusive thrombus can cause unstable angina, and acute thrombotic occlusion typically causes myocardial infarction.
